items.description: GlobAround is a desktop mashup that uses the APIs from Booli and Nestoria. It lets users search classified ads for free items from around the world. There are also sections for job listings and real estate.
The new intelligent property search engine for London. This tool uses Zoopla to aggregate and display search results.

The app allows users to search for rental apartments and houses right on Facebook. A combination of Google Map and Facebook API mashup allows users to search for rentals, share postings with friends, message them or simply chat to ask for opinion.
Uses Walk Score and Facebook Graph APIs and posts scores from any city to your Facebook wall.
Unlock knowledge of the local market and gain an edge when buying or selling real estate. Answers are provided by local real estate agents eager to represent you in a transaction.
A WordPress Plugin that conveniently displays an agent's AgentRank data- profile, sales, reviews, forecasts, etc., from RealtyBaron.

SchoolAndHousing offers school-centered online real estate searches. Search school by API test scores, region, zip code, city, county or address. Users can also search elementary, middle and high school overlapped attendance areas. Search detailed school information including test scores, demographic information, etc. and cross-reference with a local housing search.

Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
This real estate plug-in allows you to join a network of real estate web blogs who are growing their traffic through real estate Q&A.
A free site-building service that takes data from APIs and other content sources as a way for niche publishers to quickly create content-rich sites along with built-in monetization options.

View real estate information on every home around you as you move using the free Zillow iPhone App. Walk or drive through a neighborhood and see Zestimate home values, homes for sale, recently sold homes, and more.
See local area information for major us cities. See the age distribution in my city, the price per square foot, and other data. Find out by looking at this widget displaying data from Zillow.com.
Search for homes, get estimates for homes using Zillow, and find lenders for financing your home purchase.
This Facebook app allows you to connect to Zillow from Facebook. View information about your house and see what your friends houses are worth.
Property search engine for Spain of property data.
Community networking site that allows members to get in touch with their neighbours. The site uses APIs from Nestoria, flickr, Eventful and more to provide local information to users.
Kitten and cat classifieds. Find kittens for sale and adoption or list your avaialable cats for free.
Your professional world, visualized. Map your professional network to understand the relationships between you and your connections.
Service that motivates and rewards people for being active.
CrocTail provides an interface for browsing information parsed from SEC filings about several hundred thousand U.S. publicly traded corporations and their foreign subsidiaries.
Sportmeets connects online users who love sports so that they can meet, organize their teams and events and compete offline.
ChapterBoard is a web application for fraternities and sororities. Each chapter has its own private space to coordinate events, discuss topics and collect their dues.

@trafficRobot generates unique email addresses for everything you use online, so that you can control who sends you emails. All emails received go directly to your Telegram messenger. @trafficRobot connects emails, webforms, and API with Telegram. Available as a Chrome browser extension and as a bot

Google and NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defense Command, have partnered to let you track Santa and his travels from the North Pole using Google Maps and Google Earth. The Santa Tracker goes live at 6am EST on December 24th.
Share your fondest or worst memories of your first kiss on this community and mapping site. Top level map shows most recently added kiss locations on a world map.
Zendesk for voice. Talkdesk is a powerful voice customer support system. Answer customer support calls in the browser.
See in real time what's going wrong in Seattle with this great mashup of Google Maps and seattle.gov. By John Eberly.
FakeGirlfriend.co allows single guys to appear that they have a girlfriend when they actually don't. You can text the app and your fake girlfriend will text you and then call you back.
Calculate the number of calories you burn while running, bicycling, or swimming.

A map mashup for the Gold Coast of Queensland Australia, showing accommodation and attractions. Simple application using custom icons, single xml file, selectable grouping. Aims are to build the map content via user submission to the forum on the site.
A Mashup of the new WikiLocation API and Google Maps to show information about Wikipedia articles in a location.
Tracks locations of survival supplies in case of a zombie outbreak.
Blizzalert makes it so you never a miss a great day on the mountain. You select which ski areas you want to watch and Blizzalert will send text message alerts when storms are coming through.
Sightseeing via a World Video Map. Watch and map videos on Google Maps and Google Earth.
Google map mashup of crime in Washington, DC.
Weather forecasts for South Africa.
The Pinguinale 2006 is an event in Wuppertal, Germany, because of the 125 birthday of the Wuppertaler Zoo. Map shows the places of 200 pinguins and photos of them. Firefox works better.
SuittsMe is a social shopping service, that allows users to share and discuss clothes, they want to buy in future.

San Diego School Pal is the easiest way to see San Diego's school districts and their associated levels of crime. We combine a school district map with the 2011 San Diego crime database and Megan's Law statistics. Browse across a map view of San Diego, combined with overlay regions for each of the school districts, covering elementary, high school, and unified. Enter your address to search and locate your own school district or browse the list to get statistics across the city. Share your opinion and thoughts about any San Diego school district with the built-in commenting system, and help others find the best one for their needs.
Comprehensive map of libraries in Denmark. Shows head libraries = Hovedbiblioteker. Shows public libraries = folkebiblioteker. Shows mobile libraries = Bogbusser.

Browse through all the mountains of the world categorized by continent, country. The mountain coordinates are mapped in Google maps, along with photos got from flickr. Provision is given to visit the details about the mountain in Wikipedia from the Map
Generate video playlists of YouTube videos related to your search term and watch the videos back to back. Embed a playlist in your blog.

See lots of useful bus route and status data on this CTA mashup for the Chicago Transit Authority. Lets you click on a link for Route Progress and set an alarm to receive a pop-up notification on your computer when a bus has reached a selected stop.
A map of crime in Richmond, Virginia's Church Hill Neighborhood going back to 2001.
Shows locations of Speed Cameras on a map. Contains most speed cameras in Europe. This information is not intended to encourage speeding.
Personalized healthy recipes in your inbox. Add items that you love to eat like Chinese, apples, or pancakes, and we'll email you a healthy recipe each day to make.

To assist users when making Uber requests, SurgeProtector lets one know if the area they are in is currently experiencing peek pricing. This is filterable buy specific Uber model. If there is no surge, users can request a ride from within the app.

Holidayen is an intuitive, automated trip planner that helps travelers plan and book amazing, personalized holiday experiences in more than 300 destinations worldwide. It creates a customized itinerary for the traveler with all relevant details, reducing travel planning time from several weeks to a few minutes.
Downloads all your followers from Twitter and displays the five oldest based on the date that the user began following you.
Tour of California Cycling Blog covers 100+ mile bike rides. GPS satellite data, route profiles, pictures, and more information is available.
Mashup to get nformation about your local events. Uses Eventful and Google Maps.
Up to 2 Gb to share geolocated photos.
Find the altitude of any place with a point-and-click interface.

Elsy Arres Flights is a web application that lets users search for upcoming flights by providing their departure location, and their destination. This application uses the Elsy Arres Flights API service.
Find a roommate using Google Maps. Roommates enter the location of where they would be willing to live, and then you can search based on this.

Explore travellr is a mashup that searches content from Flickr, Google Maps, and YouTube, and displays useful posts filtered by city, state, or activity. Type New York City and see what comes up, or maybe try searching for skiing in japan.
An interactive map that displays news for the specific country you click on. A Google Maps, Google News, and Geonames.org mashup.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send faxes of documents stored in their Box accounts using eFax.
Map-based price and fuel quality reporting community covering Brazil. Try searching for Rio de Janeiro
See if it will freeze in your area tonight. Uses HTML5 and is geolocation-enabled to quickly check weather conditions on mobile and desktop browsers.

Helps shoppers capitalize on price guarantees on recent purchases. Add your purchase information and they will watch for price decreases and automatically notify you if price falls below your purchase price.
MP3 Search Engine
Like TinyUrl.com but for Google Maps, for example http//useamap.com/lotto . You select the tag name. One click to create a map. No login needed. Free. Just launched on 9th October.
MailPeak uses the Twilio API to turn webmail accounts into voicemail. Listen and send voice replies to your emails from any phone.
This Google Maps Mashup maps out the latest GeoTagged YouTube videos which are tagged with Egypt Protests.
ThyNews is a social news reader to let you create and share your own custom online newspaper page full of headline links from the news sources you trust.
Dating site that also incorporates YouTube videos.
A free classified site for RVs and trailers. This mashup makes use of the Oodle, Google AdSense, and Google Maps APIs.
Find and map a variety of local information including blog posts, art gallery reviews, real estate listings, police reports.
Winner of the Sunlight Foundation Mashup Congress Contest. Get more insight into the truth of campaign finance with this interactive network maps of state level political contribution data.

FindHorsesForSale.net lets horse shoppers find horses around the wold. Users can view pictures, price, location, breed info, nearby stables, estimated payments, estimated shipping costs, and estimated yearly food costs.
Browse photos by Arab country name.
Bitcoin ATM uses AngularJS and the Coinkite API to simulate a Bitcoin vending machine. In addition to Bitcoins, it can also dispense Litecoins and Blackcoins.
Geo-location of parishes and churches in Spain and other countries, plus schedules and service times.

With GoLater, Evernote becomes a Mobile Map Content Managent System. With the solution, you can collect all the interesting places and check out their contents also maps or routes anywhere anytime under network connection.
Hangman game for Flickr tags. Guess all the letters of a tag and see 4 photos.
Meteo Malineo is a web application that provides free weather forecast for France, over 10,000 cities. The application uses Open Weather Map API.

Frame an ecard using this web tool using photos from your own computer, from a remote site using a web address or from your Flickr account. Then send it via email as an ecard or save it to your Flickr account.

A product-rating engine that collects product data, including over 600,000 products and more than 1.6 million reviews through web crawlers and APIs. Giddi runs this data through an algorithm to generate proprietary ratings for each product.
Find hunting guides and outfitters by location or game.

Taaza.com is one of the leading job search engine sites in India which aggregates jobs from all leading job sites in the country. Taaza is a multi-dimensional Indian portal that has various sections like jobs, travel guide, personal finance, online classifieds and news. Taaza also owns a US focused job aggregating site - usjobs.com
Real-time HTML/CSS/Javascript editor and advanced Search Engine dedicated to web development and design.

The Lobby Sign In Management Application is a product built by DocuSign that helps customers and partners bring their lobbies into the 21st Century. The Lobby Sign In Application helps manage who is in the building, makes sure different people sign in in an appropriate way (Visitors sign an NDA, for example) and tracks all of that inside the Application.
Ever wondered where all your Flickr photos were, or how many places have photos tagged Paris? This app should answer all your questions.
A map of the most expensive stadiums around the world.
An online flirtation site that lets you anonymously send pre-defined sms messages to people you know and check the read status.

Follow high school recruits as they choose which Division 1 college football team will get their commitment. View recruiting information by state, or university, as well as viewing recruits within a 100 mile radius of your zip.

Hotel mashups of Google Map, more then 30.000 hotels to locate on the map. View hotels on the map with Panoramic street view of the location where available. APIs used Hotel Club, Google Maps and Street Cities.

A generative artwork that explores how advertising uses and manipulates language. Real corporate slogans are remixed and randomized to generate invented slogans, then paired with Flickr images, generating fake advertisements on the fly.

CoinDesk has a Bitcoin Price Ticker widget that can be embedded for free into your own website or blog. The widget displays the current Bitcoin Price Index, todayâ€™s high and low, and a sparkline showing price movements over the last sixty minutes.
Use the MyShopping application for Facebook to connect with friends, co-workers, or family on your daily shopping activities.
See George W's life history plotted on this Google Map.
Marketplacedigger.com is designed to help shoppers easily find, compare and buy anything online from marketplace merchants in less time.

Tries to simulate the simple joys of talking over CB radio on the highway. Just call in and enter the number of a highway and you will be entered into a group chat with other people traveling along the same road.
French real estate, roommate and job mashup.

Jay Crim and Shekar Davarya spent the summer of 2002 driving across the country on Route 66, collecting interviews with the people who live, work and travel on the old road. This multimedia map is the result. Built with the new My Maps service.
